Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

arpirisk (development version)

  • New predict_risk() adds the predicted 4-year risk of death with ADT alone (baseline_risk), with an ARPI plus ADT (arpi_risk), or both, chosen with treatment = c("adt", "arpi"). The risk with an ARPI is the baseline risk minus the absolute risk difference at that risk; when it is requested, baseline risks outside the range in which treatment effects were estimated give the same warning as in estimate_treatment_effect().
  • predict_baseline_risk() is deprecated. Use predict_risk(treatment = "adt"), which returns the same columns.

arpirisk 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • predict_baseline_risk() adds to a data frame of patients each patient’s linear predictor and predicted 4-year risk of all-cause death with androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) alone, from a Cox model with 9 predictors (model version 261002-raw-rcs).
  • estimate_treatment_effect() adds the baseline risk and the treatment effects of adding an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) to ADT at that risk: the 4-year absolute risk difference, the restricted mean survival time difference through 4 years, and the hazard ratio, each with a 95% confidence interval.
  • Both functions check the inputs: missing or impossible values stop with an error naming the row and input, and values outside the trial data give a warning. model_inputs() lists the inputs with their units and accepted values; mhspc_model() loads the model specification.
  • example_patients provides 6 synthetic patients spanning the range of baseline risk.
  • The lower-level functions used by the web calculator (https://github.com/wfukuokaya/arpirisk-app) are documented in ?"app-api".
